faqs.question: How do I know this fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the HP 250 G7, 255 G7 and 256 G7, which share the same body. Send us a photo of your laptop on WhatsApp if you're unsure.

faqs.question: Does this include the keyboard?
faqs.answer: No, the keyboard is sold separately — this is the bare palmrest and bottom base.

faqs.question: What does 'Part CD' cover?
faqs.answer: Part CD is the chassis section — the upper palmrest with touchpad and the bottom base. It doesn't include the screen lid — that's Part AB.

faqs.question: Can I fit this myself?
faqs.answer: It involves a full teardown of the laptop, so most customers have it fitted by us. We can talk you through it on WhatsApp if you'd rather do it yourself.
